Play tip · Chapter 2

No free garage slot, no registration

Every registration consumes a garage slot, and your vehicle roster starts at just three slots. Purchasable garages add only one slot each regardless of price, while the free story garages are the generous ones — Thompson Court holds two and Pegassi Residences holds three. If registration is refused, a full roster is the first thing to check.

Source

Source: GTA 6 Garage Guide: Locations and Prices — Mobalytics (2026-11-21).
